title: Chicken Katsu Curry
subtitle: Crispy panko chicken with Japanese curry sauce and rice
excerpt: Panko-breaded chicken breast, fried until golden and crisp, served with a mild, deeply savoury Japanese curry sauce over steamed rice. The most popular dish in the Japanese fast-casual repertoire.

recipe.sourceNotes: Katsu curry (katsukare) combines two Western-influenced dishes that entered Japanese cooking in the Meiji era (1868 to 1912): tonkatsu (breaded pork cutlet, derived from the Austrian Wiener schnitzel) and Japanese curry (kare), adapted from British curry powder brought to Japan via the British Indian curry. Japanese curry is notably different from Indian or British curry: it is milder, sweeter, slightly thicker, and relies on a roux-based curry sauce. Chicken katsu (katsudori) is a later variant of the pork original and is now the most widely eaten form outside Japan.

recipeTools.notes: Chicken is done at 74 C internal.

content.text: Pound the chicken breasts to an even thickness before breading: an even cutlet cooks through at the same rate from edge to centre. The oil temperature for frying should be around 170 C. Too cool and the panko absorbs oil and goes greasy; too hot and the outside burns before the centre is cooked through. A cube of bread should turn golden in about 30 seconds at the right temperature.

items.preparation: about 200 g each, pounded to 1.5 cm

content.text: Make the curry sauce: heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion for 10 minutes until golden. Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder. Stir for 2 minutes. Add the flour and stir for 1 minute. Gradually add the stock, whisking until smooth. Add the soy sauce and honey. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Blend smooth with a stick blender.
Season the chicken with salt. Set up three bowls: flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs. Dust each breast in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into the panko.
Heat the oil for frying in a frying pan over medium heat to 170 C. Fry the breaded chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper. Slice diagonally.
Serve the chicken sliced over steamed rice, with the curry sauce poured alongside. Add pickled ginger if you like.
